proposals.title: Proposal 4 – Shareholder Proposal Concerning Shareholder Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, including initiating any appropriate topic.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting against the proposal for the reasons discussed below.](no)

proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Access to COVID-19 Products
proposals.proponent: The Province of Saint Joseph of the Capuchin Order and other co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Merck to report on whether and how receipt of public financial support for COVID-19 products is considered when making decisions affecting access, such as pricing.
proposals.evidence: The Board has considered this shareholder proposal carefully and recommends a vote AGAINST it.
